title: Unlock All Recipes
description: Unlocks all recipes for each player on join. Optimized and very efficient for survival servers.
body:
> If this project helped you, please consider leaving some stars [on the Github](https://github.com/Derec-Mods)! 

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/donate/kofi-singular-alt_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/derexxd) 



Following the [VanillaTweaks datapack version](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks/), I wanted to make my own in Java code form and now am sharing it with the Minecraft community. This version caches the recipes all on startup for improved performance, and functions virtually the same. 

_This was created for use on my forever world, called "derex smp". Check it out in action, server ip: `mc.longhorns.dev`_
